requirements.requirement: The system must define a triage result object containing recruiting_status, condition_match, pass_flag, and explanation_text fields.
The system must represent recruiting_status as a normalized enum (e.g., RECRUITING, NOT_RECRUITING, UNKNOWN) compatible with backend output.
The system must represent condition_match as a boolean indicating whether the trial matches the user’s condition.
The system must represent pass_flag as a boolean indicating overall triage outcome (pass or fail).
The system must include explanation_text as a human-readable string summarizing the triage decision.
The system must ensure the triage contract structure is compatible with MessageBubble.tsx props without requiring structural transformation.
The system must align field names and types with the backend clinical_trials_service.py output or explicitly define a mapping layer.
The system must support inclusion of multiple triage result objects in a list for rendering multiple trials in a single response.
The system must ensure the contract preserves ordering metadata so recruiting_status and condition_match can be rendered before other fields.
The system must allow explanation_text to be safely rendered as plain text without requiring HTML parsing.
The system must define default fallback values for missing fields (e.g., UNKNOWN for recruiting_status, false for booleans, empty string for explanation_text).
The system must handle backend responses missing the triage object by returning a null-safe empty triage structure.
The system must reject or flag triage objects with invalid data types (e.g., non-boolean pass_flag) before reaching the UI layer.
The system must ensure the contract is serializable to JSON for transmission between backend and frontend.
